title: Antarctic Ice Marathon — 2025 race results
claims: The 2025 men's marathon podium is Denis Nazarov 3:54:49, Rune Buyl 4:18:25 and Charles Brown 4:27:14.
The 2025 women's marathon podium is Catherine Drysdale 3:48:43, Joanna Drewnicka-Ogrodnik 4:18:05 and Victoria Grahn 4:25:22.
The 2025 results page also lists a half marathon, 50 km and other distances; this page uses only the marathon podium.
